title: Kimi K3.1 Pro: 1M Token Context
hook: How many tokens can K3.1 Pro process at once?
voice_text: How many tokens can K3.1 Pro process at once? One million. Moonshot AI released this open-weight model with a massive context window. It also runs 2 to 3 times faster in its Highspeed variant. On Terminal-Bench 4.0, it scored 65.7%. That puts it ahead of GPT-6 Astra. However, the full model weights are not available until November 4. You can access it now on the Kimi API. Check the release date if you plan to self-host.
broll_query: Moonshot AI Kimi K3.1 Pro interface, code scrolling, terminal logs, network diagram, server rack

Source: https://www.kimi.ai/blog/kimi-k3-1-pro

claims.claim: Across coding, agentic, and knowledge benchmarks, K3.1 Pro matches or approaches the strongest proprietary models.
claims.quote: Across coding, agentic, and knowledge benchmarks, K3.1 Pro matches or approaches the strongest proprietary models.

claims.claim: On Terminal-Bench 4.0 , which evaluates coding agents on realistic, resource-constrained terminal tasks using strict task-specific tests, K3.1 Pro scores 65.7%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%) .
claims.quote: On Terminal-Bench 4.0 , which evaluates coding agents on realistic, resource-constrained terminal tasks using strict task-specific tests, K3.1 Pro scores 65.7%, ahead of GPT-6 Astra (58.2%) and narrowly behind Claude Opus 5.5 (66.4%) .

claims.claim: And on Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon , our internal benchmark that tests coding agents' multi-step execution, tool use, and end-to-end problem solving across diverse engineering domains, K3.1 Pro scores 61.2% , above K3's 55.95% .
claims.quote: And on Kimi Code Bench 3.0 Long-horizon , our internal benchmark that tests coding agents' multi-step execution, tool use, and end-to-end problem solving across diverse engineering domains, K3.1 Pro scores 61.2% , above K3's 55.95% .

claims.claim: Coding K3.1 Pro covers the full range of coding work, from quick fixes in real codebases to full-project builds.
claims.quote: Coding K3.1 Pro covers the full range of coding work, from quick fixes in real codebases to full-project builds.

claims.claim: K3.1 Pro works effectively across game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot , combining them with web search and 3D generation to create complete experiences.
claims.quote: K3.1 Pro works effectively across game engines such as Unity, Unreal Engine, and Godot , combining them with web search and 3D generation to create complete experiences.

claims.claim: In one internal test, it built a human walking dynamics simulator with integrated training and evaluation pipelines on top of human-atlas , an open-source anatomical model of the human body comprising 296 skeletal components, including cartilage, and 402 muscle components.
claims.quote: In one internal test, it built a human walking dynamics simulator with integrated training and evaluation pipelines on top of human-atlas , an open-source anatomical model of the human body comprising 296 skeletal components, including cartilage, and 402 muscle components.

claims.claim: Across 167 missions and 420 independent reviews, it analyzed experimental results, diagnosed problems, and iteratively refined the walking controller, enabling the simulated human to go from collapsing within seconds to walking continuously with alternating strides for 11.2 seconds.
